title: Refill - pharmacy
text: Patient called stating the pharmacy has not received the prescription yet.

title: Voicemail
text: Called patient - no answer. Left voicemail requesting a return call.

title: Prior auth
text: Insurance denied prior authorization. Team will submit the appeal per workflow.

title: Wait time
text: Patient expressed concern about wait time. Apologized and offered a supervisor callback.

title: Portal message
text: Portal message reviewed and routed to the provider for a clinical response.

title: Opening line
text: Thank you for calling Siya Health. How may I help you today?

title: Pull chart
text: One moment please - let me pull up your chart and confirm your visit details.

title: Empathy
text: I hear you - I'm here to help. Can you tell me what happened?

title: Provider unavailable
text: Dr. Smith is unavailable today. We will contact you shortly to arrange the next appointment.

title: Heads up
text: Heads up - the provider is running fifteen minutes behind today.

title: Circle back
text: I'll circle back with billing once I have the invoice number.

title: Touch base
text: Let's touch base after your shift about the backlog on the schedule.

title: Secure channel
text: Please send that through the patient portal or approved secure channel - not personal email.

title: Follow-up
text: I'll follow up tomorrow if we don't hear back from billing by then.

title: Escalation
text: I'll loop in the supervisor with a short summary - no patient identifiers in this thread.
